scope_detail: The author deposit supplies adoption and firm-level serious/label indicators but no executable analysis. SAS aggregate checks verified candidate annual inputs; exact firm-year U.S. Listing/New Markets status, original-vintage Index Member agreement, and Table 6 reporting-level controls/screens were not reconstructed or validated. No faithful Table 6 regression was run.

target.equation: EconCon = a0 + a1*IAS + a2*SeriousAdopters + controls + fixed effects + error
target.serious_adopter_exposure: IAS-year indicator multiplied by the deposited firm-level serious indicator
common_specification: country, year, and industry fixed effects
U.S. Listing, U.S.-GAAP, New Markets, and Index Member controls
IAS observations limited to the first five adoption years
reporting-variable level control contemporaneous except pre-adoption mean for IAS adopters
sample requires total assets of at least USD 10 million and countries with at least one voluntary IAS observation

outcomes.price_impact: Log yearly median of absolute daily stock return divided by USD trading volume; zero-return days omitted. Annual measure is computed from fiscal-year-end month -2 through +10.
outcomes.bid_ask_spread: Log yearly median of daily quoted spread, (closing ask - closing bid) / midpoint, over fiscal-year-end month -2 through +10.
outcomes.cost_of_capital: Mean implied equity cost from Claus-Thomas, Gebhardt-Lee-Swaminathan, Easton, and Ohlson-Juettner-Nauroth models; the local Hail and Leuz (2006) appendix supplies formulas and input timing.

Index Member is time-invariant under the cited 2008 definition, but agreement of the local current header with the authors' original extraction vintage is unknown.

aggregate_preflight.output_policy: aggregate counts only; no firm-level observations printed or exported

regressions.detail: No model-ready panel was built because the common listing/status controls, reporting-level controls, and screening rules were not validated as firm-year inputs. Native Stata was not invoked; no partial/proxy fit is reported.

limitations: No author executable code was present in the deposit; the analysis workflow was reconstructed only to the extent defined by Table 6 and its notes.
The DS-to-Worldscope link table's date fields are labeled as Datastream price coverage dates, not explicit crosswalk-vintage dates; the counts are candidate annual-link diagnostics only.

The local Daske et al. (2008) paper supplies the New Markets venue list and says Index Member is time-invariant. Firm-year U.S. Listing/New Markets statuses are not in the deposit; the current local index value does not establish agreement with the authors’ original extraction vintage.

The deposit contains firm-level serious/label flags, not yearly continuous reporting-variable controls or pre-adoption means. Local source inputs were not transformed into those controls in this bounded preflight.
The Table 6 sample screens (including the minimum total-assets threshold and country eligibility) were not reconstructed.
Hail and Leuz (2006) provides the cost-of-capital methods, but the required forecast, book-value, payout, inflation, and forecast-bias coverage was not built or checked for the target sample.
Table 3 average-adoption regressions are distinct from the Table 6 heterogeneity targets and were not substituted.
No proxy for New Markets membership, U.S. Listing, industry history, or any outcome was created; no annual Index Member history was assumed.
